text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki is injured during training, so I hastily escort her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ngh… It seems the state of my injury is more unfavorable than I first thought.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That said, even if I have to suffer pain, I must continue making progress.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: They do say that a clear head remains cool amidst any blaze. I ask that you allow me to continue my training.
choice_data_list: Let's wait until you've fully recovered before we resume training.
Okay, but we'll avoid anything strenuous.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll endeavor not to strain myself while running, so please…
choice_data_list: You might end up hurting your form while trying to adjust.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I see. If I push on with my training, it could have the opposite effect and set me back…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Very well. I shall focus on recuperating until I'm back to full health.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki sounds disappointed as she heads back to her dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Thank you for understanding. Let's hurry back to the track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although I only tasked her with a light run to check her condition, Yaeno Muteki's face contorts with pain.
choice_data_list: I was afraid this would happen. That's enough for today.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm truly sorry for the trouble. I'll take your advice to heart and rest for the remainder of the day.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm ashamed indeed to have made such a disgraceful display…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki appears to be in a lot of pain as she slowly makes her way back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Whew… It seems I'll manage as long as the exercise isn't especially demanding.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'll stick to light training of this nature until my body is fully recovered!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki completes a light training session while taking care not to aggravate her injury.
